cell-potential.def: The voltage of an electrochemical cell, E. Under standard conditions E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode), where each E° is a standard reduction potential; a positive E°cell means a favored reaction.

faraday-constant.def: F = 96,485 C/mol e⁻, the charge on one mole of electrons. It links cell potential to free energy, ΔG° = −nFE°.
